career_ladder.note: Technical cadre hierarchy within Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL / Mahavitaran), the largest state power distribution utility in India. Promotion from Junior Engineer up to Chief Engineer is governed by MSEDCL Employees' Service Regulations and Departmental Promotion Committee (DPC) criteria based on seniority, annual confidential performance reports, and departmental examinations.

exam_scheme.note: Conducted as an online Computer Based Test (CBT) by the Institute of Banking Personnel Selection (IBPS) on behalf of MSEDCL. The test comprises 130 objective questions carrying a total of 150 marks over 120 minutes. Negative marking is applicable at 0.25 (1/4th) of the marks assigned to each specific question for wrong answers. There is no interview for the post of Junior Engineer; selection is determined entirely by CBT merit.

financial_package.note: MSEDCL is a state power distribution public sector undertaking owned by the Government of Maharashtra under MSEB Holding Company Ltd. Pay scales are established under tripartite wage revision settlements, strictly distinct from the Central 7th CPC matrix.
financial_package.pay_source_label: MSEDCL Recruitment Advertisement No. 05/2023, Section 2 (Junior Engineer Dist/Civil: ₹37,340 – ₹1,03,775)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Pay Group III entry basic pay of ₹37,340 with 58% DA (₹21,657 effective 01.07.2025), HRA (9% to 27% based on city tier: ₹3,361 to ₹10,082), technical duty allowance, net of Contributory Provident Fund (12% of basic + DA = ₹7,080), profession tax (₹200), and contributory medical insurance deductions.
official_perks: Residential accommodation in company substation colonies or House Rent Allowance (HRA)
Contributory Provident Fund (CPF) and Gratuity under MSEDCL Rules
